messages:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only rollout now. Changes: routing.policy=\"fair_share\" (global), batch.max_tokens 1024 -> 768, request.timeout_ms 60000 -> 45000. Canary 3% for 15m in prod (us-east-1, eu-west-1). Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Initiated by maya. :package_deploy:

maya: ack. I pushed the change to config repo and kicked the deploy run: https://deploy.internal/runs/1752509999

alex: noted. observers: per-route p50/p90, errors, kvcache hitrate, tenant throttles. I'll wire a quick dashboard alert for >15% error or +20% p90

sam: oncall here. watching latency and OOMs. tagging current oncall: @ruth-oncall

leo: small nit — fair_share will change tenant weighting, watch high-qps tenants. We should pin critical tenants until we confirm behavior.

maya: good call. pinning tenant routing for 3 tenants (payments, search, core-svc) to model variant v1.3.2 to avoid fallback re-routing.

alex: confirm canary route traffic: /text/generate + /chat/stream. Everything else stays steady.

deploy-bot: Canary started — 3% traffic in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Will report at +5m and +15m.

leo: quick perf note: batch.max_tokens drop can lower token throughput but may increase per-request latency for long-prompts. watch tail latencies.

maya: copying the config snippet we pushed:

```
routing:
  policy: fair_share
batch:
  max_tokens: 768
request:
  timeout_ms: 45000
canary:
  percent: 3
  duration_min: 15
```

sam: +1. watching dashboards. If errors >10% or p90 +30% -> pause.

(deploy-bot): Canary 5m update: us-east-1 p90 +18%, errors +8% — eu-west stable. No OOMs.

alex: thanks. That p90 move is borderline but within threshold. keep an eye.

(deploy-bot): Canary 12m update: us-east-1 p90 +32%, errors +22%, kvcache hitrate down 15%. autoscaler spin-ups normal.

maya: pause the rollout. reverting batching/timeouts for canary traffic only. keeping routing.policy as fair_share but reduce canary to 1% while we investigate.

deploy-bot: Pause accepted. Applying canary adjustments: batch.max_tokens -> 1024 for canary slice, request.timeout_ms -> 60000 for canary. Canary percent -> 1%.

sam: good call. continuing observation.

leo: preliminary hypothesis: smaller batch reduced kvcache-friendly prefixes, causing more KV misses and longer decoder paths on long-history chats. Need offline sim with representative long-prompt traces before trying again.

alex: agree. let's not reattempt a full roll until we have an offline sim + perf run. For now leave fair_share in place at low canary, but don't expand.

maya: will update the release notes and mark the rollout as \"paused and partial rollback\": https://internal/notes/1752509999

ruth-oncall: monitoring — us-east p90 trending back down to +10% after revert. errors also dropping. will call if it fluctuates.

deploy-bot: Canary adjustments applied. Summary: batching/timeouts reverted for canary slice, routing.policy unchanged but canary at 1%. No global rollout.

maya: followups: 1) run offline perf with long-prompt trace set, 2) try incremental batch change with smaller step (1024->900), 3) consider kv cache warmup flags for batch changes. I'll file a postmortem and plan a reattempt in a maintenance window after tests.

alex: SGTM. tagging engineering checklist items in the runbook.

sam: closing the monitoring loop, will escalate if anything new pops up. :thumbsup:

leo: I'll run the offline sim and post results in threads/1752519000.

maya: thanks all — marking this rollout as \"paused - partial revert\". We'll reopen when sim + canary plan ready.

deploy-bot: Run status: PAUSED (partial rollback applied). End of thread."
